Title: iPhone Duo - Apple
# iPhone Duo. Pre-order starting 5:00 a.m. PT on October sixteenth. ## Get the highlights. * The largest iPhone display ever. Reimagined iOS experiences for ultimate versatility. And all‑new ways to shoot from front to back. A new iPhone enters the fold. Introducing iPhone Duo, the first foldable iPhone. When open, it’s the thinnest iPhone with **the largest display ever — 50 percent larger than iPhone 18 Pro Max**. And it has an outer display with more than 90 percent of the screen area of iPhone 18 Pro. Through reimagined iOS experiences, it offers unparalleled versatility in all-new poses and orientations. All in a durable, pocketable design. It’s an iPhone unlike any iPhone. A new iPhone enters the fold. When open, the dual display system features **the largest, thinnest iPhone display ever**. Through reimagined iOS experiences, it offers unparalleled versatility in all-new poses and orientations. All in a pocketable design. * **Foldable design.** Offers exceptional viewing experiences in a design that fits in your pocket. Pin a video to the top and watch it while using another app. And you get more vertical space for apps. * **Seated.** Set iPhone Duo down and watch a show or follow a workout at the perfect viewing angle — with easy access to the controls on the bottom. * **Standing.** Display a bedside clock, photos, widgets, and more with StandBy. And watch movies and shows at an adjustable angle on the outer display. iPhone Duo offers the most immersive viewing experience of any iPhone. The aspect ratio of the 7.6‑inch Super Retina XDR display4 is consistent across the inner and outer display. And the **under‑display FaceTime camera** is hidden until you need it. iPhone Duo opened in vertical position and iPhone 18 Pro Max side by side, both with the same image of a person with red hair who is dressed in red, iPhone Duo showing more of the image due to the larger screen. Like watching your favorite movies or shows on the outer display at just the right angle. iPhone Duo, Star White color, slightly open, Camera app on outer display with Center Stage front camera, inner display shows Photos app library.

Title: iPhone Duo : Apple Forums | Product Hunt
# iPhone Duo - The largest iPhone display ever. In a thin, foldable design. Introducing iPhone Duo, the first foldable iPhone. When open, it’s the thinnest iPhone with the largest display ever — 50 percent larger than iPhone 18 Pro Max. And it has an outer display with more than 90 percent of the screen area of iPhone 18 Pro. Through reimagined iOS experiences, it offers unparalleled versatility in all-new poses and orientations. All in a durable, pocketable design. It’s an iPhone unlike any iPhone. Steve did the Job so Tim could Cook, and now it's John's Turnus. Honestly this feels like a suitable replacement for the little iPad Mini that *could*, which I loved so much. @chrismessina I loved that ipad mini too. @chrismessina Chris my whole X feed is basically iPad Mini content right now This really took over. @chrismessina the mini's argument was always one handed reading at a size a phone could not reach. if the outer screen covers ordinary phone use, that job folds into a device you were already carrying. curious whether the crease shows up in reading mode. @chrismessina Looks like I can trade in my iPhone and iPad for a new iPhone Duo. @chrismessina job, cook, turnus lol 😁. I like duo, but what about ipad minis? Duo is the foldable ipad mini we need now. The opening animation is crazy good! It feels like the outside screen becomes a transparent glass the moment you start opening it. These are exactly the small details that make Apple's iterations on existing stuff stand out. It is refreshing to see these again. I might switch from my Samsung S26 Ultra (with S Pen). not a fan of foldable screens, but this looks good! @chrismessina why siri looks like disabled version of ai assistant. The hardware is great and One UI is nice, but third-party app support is so disappointing. I love how ios developers adapt their apps to new devices and OS on day one. I loved that ipad mini and duo is a good choice !! This is pretty sick, but I don't love how big and heavy it will feel in my pocket.
